test_network_debug_report_records_httpx_: test that network debug report correctly records httpx GET requests with timing and status
enable_network_debug_report: enable network debug reporting to capture outgoing httpx request details and timing
disable_network_debug_report: disable network debug reporting to stop capturing outgoing request details
get_network_debug_report: get the collected network debug report as a dictionary with request entries and timing
format_network_debug_report: format the network debug report into a human-readable summary string with slowest requests
